605	We characterize PermG detection power via simulation under a controlled data-generating process (DGP) that matches the structure of our iterative training time series.

607	\paragraph{DGP.}
608	For each trial, we generate a bivariate system $(X_t, Y_t)$ for $t = 1, \ldots, T$ where $X_t = \mu + \epsilon_t^X$ and $Y_t = \mu + \beta X_{t-1} + \epsilon_t^Y$, with $\epsilon \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \sigma^2)$ and $\sigma{=}1$.
609	The coupling parameter $\beta$ controls signal strength; $\beta{=}0$ is the null.
610	The linear coupling provides a power lower bound; nonlinear dynamics in actual iterative training may yield different power characteristics.
611	We sweep $\beta \in [0, 2]$ across $T \in \{6, 8, 10, 15, 20\}$, running 100 replications per $(\beta, T)$ cell with 5{,}000 permutations each and BH FDR correction at $q{=}0.05$ across 8 hypothetical pairs (matching the experimental setup).

\section{PermG Power Analysis}
\label{app:power_analysis}

We characterize PermG detection power via simulation under a controlled data-generating process (DGP) that matches the structure of our iterative training time series.

\paragraph{DGP.}
For each trial, we generate a bivariate system $(X_t, Y_t)$ for $t = 1, \ldots, T$ where $X_t = \mu + \epsilon_t^X$ and $Y_t = \mu + \beta X_{t-1} + \epsilon_t^Y$, with $\epsilon \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \sigma^2)$ and $\sigma{=}1$.
The coupling parameter $\beta$ controls signal strength; $\beta{=}0$ is the null.
The linear coupling provides a power lower bound; nonlinear dynamics in actual iterative training may yield different power characteristics.
We sweep $\beta \in [0, 2]$ across $T \in \{6, 8, 10, 15, 20\}$, running 100 replications per $(\beta, T)$ cell with 5{,}000 permutations each and BH FDR correction at $q{=}0.05$ across 8 hypothetical pairs (matching the experimental setup).

\paragraph{Results.}
Table~\ref{tab:beta50} reports $\beta_{50}$, the coupling strength required for 50\% detection power, at each observation length $T$.
Under $\sqrt{T}$ scaling, the product $\beta_{50} \cdot \sqrt{T}$ should be constant; the observed decrease from 5.09 ($T{=}8$) to 2.68 ($T{=}20$) indicates that power grows faster than $\sqrt{T}$, with the empirical scaling closer to $T^{-1.1}$.
The $\sqrt{T}$ formula in \S\ref{sec:theory} thus provides a conservative lower bound on detection power: actual power at $T{=}20$ exceeds the $\sqrt{T}$ prediction.

The phase-diagram structure is qualitatively preserved at 1.4B scale.
ECE maintains monotonic growth across all three tested $\alpha$ levels (3/3 cross-scale robust), and the binary detection pattern (above vs.\ below $\alpha_c$) is consistent with the 410M phase diagram.
On the 6-pair basis (MAUVE excluded due to systematic floor ${\sim}0.033$; Table~\ref{tab:14b_phase}), PermG forward detection at 1.4B ranges from 0/6 ($\alpha{=}0.45$, $T{=}10$) to 6/6 ($\alpha{\geq}0.60$, $T{=}15$); token entropy exhibits one-step saturation ($27$--$39\%$ drop from generation~0 to~1), reducing temporal resolution for entropy-based pairs.
Seed s42 shows PermG$_\text{rev}{=}0/6$ across all eight 1.4B conditions ($4\alpha{\times}2T$), confirming that bidirectionality is seed-specific rather than scale-inherent.
The 410M sync-dip ($\alpha{=}0.60$: 0/8 at $T{\leq}20$) does not reproduce at 1.4B (4/6 at $T{=}10$); whether this reflects scale-dependent dynamics or Pythia-specific effects remains open with only two model sizes tested.
At $T{=}15$, scale effects are $\alpha$-conditional: $\alpha{=}0.60$ reaches 6/6, while $\alpha{=}0.50$ attenuates to 3/6 (vs 4/6 at $T{=}10$), confirming that detection loss is onset-localized rather than uniform.
The boundary's $T$-dependence is preserved: $\alpha{=}0.45$ rises from 0/6 ($T{=}10$) to 3/6 ($T{=}15$), mirroring the 410M boundary shift.
However, method-level heterogeneity emerges: Toda--Yamamoto exhibits a non-monotonic pattern at $T{=}15$, inverting the PermG ordering in the mid-$\alpha$ range; gradual low-$\alpha$ dynamics preserve VAR lag structure, while rapid entropy saturation disrupts lag dependence at intermediate $\alpha$, with recovery at $\alpha{=}0.75$ where extreme collapse dynamics (PPL drift ${+}390\%$) generate sufficient temporal variation to support VAR detection.
Onset-zone attenuation is $\alpha$-invariant at 1.4B: both $\alpha{=}0.45$ and $0.50$ yield 3/6 at $T{=}15$.

On a unified 6-pair basis (MAUVE excluded due to systematic floor at ${\sim}0.033$; Table~\ref{tab:14b_phase}), third-seed replication (s44) at $T{=}10$ confirms ceiling detection above onset (6/6 at $\alpha{\geq}0.50$) with 0/6 at $\alpha{=}0.45$, validating the blind zone.
Cross-$T$ improvement holds at 3/4 $\alpha$ values ($\alpha{=}0.45$: $0/6{\to}5/6$; $\alpha{=}0.60$: $6/6{\to}6/6$; $\alpha{=}0.75$: $6/6{\to}6/6$), validating the predicted $\alpha_c(T)$ decrease; at onset ($\alpha{=}0.50$), PermG shows a marginal decrease ($6/6{\to}3/6$), consistent with phase-boundary variability.

\paragraph{Future work.}
Extensions include multivariate VAR models for confounder testing, multi-seed replication across all six architecture families, longer training runs ($T{\geq}20$), online monitoring within training pipelines, and accumulate-mode experiments~\cite{dey2024breaking}.

现象的描述性假设，不是从模型架构或训练动力学推导的结论。β 的取值范围 CI [ 0.24, 0.78 ] 极宽，几乎兼容线性 (β≈1) 和强凹 (β≈0.25) 两种截然不同的动力学。 R2-W2: "Detectability landscape" framing 与实际内容不匹配 [AGREE]  这是我在审稿中没有单独提出但完全认同的观点。论文实际交付的是：(1) 五方法在 (α, T) 网格上的 detection rate 表；(2) PermG 的 binary detection boundary 曲线；(3) 若干特殊现象（sync dip, blind zone, sharp onset）。这更接近 "detection boundary characterization" 或 "statistical power mapping"，而非 "landscape"——后者暗示了连续的、多维的、可导航的空间。 补充 : 真正的 "landscape" 应包含检测  置信度/效力  的连续值（不仅是 detectable/not），多个检测目标（不仅是 Granger precedence），以及跨架构的系统性覆盖（而非 1 主+4 辅）。当前工作更准确的标题可能是 "Characterizing the Detection Boundary of Iterative Model Collapse via Permutation Granger Causality"。 R2-W3: 33% 跨架构不确认率 [AGREE]  与我的 W5 完全一致。5/15 失败涵盖至少 4 种不同机制（precision sensitivity, bidirectional confounding, seed dependence, architecture-specific decoupling），这不是单一可修复的问题，而是方法泛化性的系统性缺陷。 补充 : 我要进一步强调 SmolLM3-3B 的 entropy 0/4 尤其严重。Table 2 (p.8) 显示 SmolLM3-3B 在 C4 domain 上 entropy channel 完全失效——而 entropy 是论文 Proposition 1 的核心 canary metric 和整个 cascade ordering 的起点。如果 >1B 模型的 entropy 行为质变，论文的理论框架（Proposition 1-2 依赖 mode amplification 使 entropy 先降）可能从根本上不适用于大模型，这直接威胁了方法的实用价值。 R2-W4: Discussion section 过于简短 [AGREE]  Section 6 (Conclusion) 约 100 词确实过短。但需要公平地指出，论文将大量讨论内容放在了 Appendix L (Extended Discussion, p.15-16)，涵盖了 scope/generalization、domain-dependent directionality、token entropy vs. perplexity、exploratory CSD analysis、future work 等。问题不在于内容缺失，而在于  位置不当 ——关键讨论（如 directionality asymmetry, SmolLM3-3B failure analysis）应在正文中出现，而非附录。 补充 : 特别是 Appendix L 中的 "Domain-dependent directionality" 发现（WikiText PermG reverse=0/8 全条件 forward，但 C4 上 PermG reverse 7/8）非常重要——它意味着 Granger 方向性依赖于训练域，进一步限制了 generalizability。这一点被埋在 Appendix 中是不合适的。 R2-W5: Proposition 1 的理论贡献被 over-framed [REBUT]  部分反驳。R2 说 "核心步骤仅是 Jensen 不等式的直接应用"——技术上正确，但低估了贡献。Proposition 1 的价值不在于数学深度，而在于  建立了 entropy 在 mode amplification 下必然先降的形式化论证 ，从而为 canary metric 选择提供了 principled basis（而非 ad hoc 选择 entropy）。Appendix X (p.22) 的 Proof 展示了 Assumption 4 → ΔH  < 0 的完整链条，包括 Taylor expansion 和 second-order Fisher information term 的分析。 但我同意 R2 关于 Assumption 4 的批评 ：mode amplification 是一个强假设，论文在 Appendix X 中明确说 "captures the standard finite-capacity approximation effect: MLE on finite samples from a peaked distribution amplifies modes"，但没有给出何时此假设  不成立  的条件。SmolLM3-3B 的 entropy 0/4 恰好是 Assumption 4 失效的实证——论文应在正文中讨论 Assumption 4 的适用边界。 R2-W6: 与 Schaeffer et al. (2025) 的 8 种 collapse 定义关系不清晰 [AGREE]  Section 2 (p.2) 引用 Schaeffer et al. 时说 "systematize eight distinct notions of 'collapse' that this literature conflates"，但论文从未明确说明自己的检测框架（基于 entropy-diversity Granger precedence）对应 Schaeffer 的哪一种或哪几种定义。这是一个 framing gap：如果论文检测的 collapse 类型与 Schaeffer 的某些定义不对应，那么 "detectability landscape" 的 scope 就被隐式限制了。 补充 : 从论文的 metrics（token entropy, distinct-n, ECE, perplexity）和检测逻辑（分布退化导致 entropy leads diversity decline）来看，最接近的应该是 Schaeffer 的 "distributional collapse"（生成分布的多样性丧失），而非 "performance collapse"（下游任务性能下降）或 "mode collapse"（仅生成少量 modes）。论文应明确这一对应关系。 R2-W7: 未讨论为何选择经典 permutation Granger 而非 neural Granger causality [AGREE]  T=5-20 的极短序列确实是选择经典 permutation 方法的合理理由（neural methods 需要大量数据），但论文未显式说明。Appendix O (p.17) 的 non-stationarity robustness 分析使用了 bivariate AR(1) simulation，这也暗示了经典方法的适用范围，但未与 neural alternatives 做正式对比。 补充 : 不过我认为这是 MINOR 而非 MAJOR。在 T≤20 的设置下，neural Granger causality（如 Tank et al., 2021; Marcinkevičs & Vogt, 2022——论文 Section 2 已引用）几乎不可能稳定估计。论文的方法选择是合理的，只需一句话说明即可。 R2-W8: 13 个 α 值未明确列出 [REBUT]  Appendix A (Table 3, p.10) 列出了完整的 metric drift 数据，覆盖 α∈{0.00, 0.05, 0.10, 0.25, 0.46, 0.48, 0.50, 0.52, 0.60, 0.75, 1.00}（共 11 个非零 + null control）。此外 Abstract 说 "13 contamination levels"——如果加上 α=0.30 和 α=0.45（在 alpha sweep 中出现），可以凑到 13。但确实未在正文一处集中列出所有 13 个值，R2 的建议合理。 R2-W9: Figure 2 y 轴标签可读性差 [AGREE]  Figure 2 (p.7) 的双 y 轴（Token Entropy 和 Distinct-1）共用一个图，在黑白打印下区分确实困难。MINOR issue。 R2-W10: Appendix 体量过大，关键验证应在正文 [AGREE]  与 R2-W4 相关。T=20 predict-then-verify (Appendix Z, p.24)、specification curve (Appendix E, Table 9)、power analysis (Appendix N) 都是支撑核心声明的关键证据，不应仅在附录出现。建议将 Appendix Z 的 Table 29 和 Appendix N 的 Figure 3 移入正文。 R2-W11: AI writing disclosure 与 Ethics 合并 [AGREE]  MINOR。符合 ARR 格式要求即可，不影响学术内容。 R2-W12: 写作不一致 [AGREE]  MINOR。我在 W10 中也指出了 Granger precedence/causality 的术语不一致。 Questions 回应 R2-Q1: Proposition 3 的 β 有无独立于数据的理论 justification？ [AGREE]  这是 R2-W1 的核心追问。我同样认为 β 需要从模型训练动力学独立推导。目前 β=0.66 完全来自实验拟合，CI [ 0.24, 0.78 ] 兼容多种函数形式。 R2-Q2: SmolLM3-3B entropy-diversity decoupling 机制是什么？ [AGREE]  极其重要的问题。与我的 Q5 一致。如果 SmolLM3-3B 的 entropy 不遵循 Proposition 1 的 mode amplification 预测，Assumption 4 在该架构上可能不成立。需要作者解释。 R2-Q3: α 未知时如何部署？ [AGREE]  实用性的关键问题。论文的检测边界 α_ c(T) 假设已知 T（可控），但 α 在实际场景中是未知的。论文的 CUSUM 部署方案（Appendix H, p.14）提供了部分答案——使用 calibrated threshold 进行 online monitoring——但 Appendix H 也显示 CUSUM 配置对 allowance parameter k 极度敏感（Table 14-15），且在 α≤0.25 的低污染水平下性能不佳。 R2-Q4: 请列出全部 13 个 α 值 [REBUT]  如我在 R2-W8 中指出，数据散布在 Table 3 (Appendix A)、Table 1 (p.6) 和各处 alpha sweep 中。但确实应集中列出。 R2-Q5: Appendix Z 的 V1 vs V2 是否构成 post-hoc adjustment？ [AGREE]  这是一个严肃的方法论问题。Appendix Z (p.24) 展示了 V1 (git-committed, bad72ce) 和 V2 (pre-analysis, not committed) 两个版本的 T=20 预测。V1 使用 raw p-values，V2 使用 BH-FDR correction——这确实是一个 post-hoc 的分析决策调整。虽然论文声称 V2 "created 44 minutes before pre-analysis" 并试图通过 git timestamp 建立时间线，但 (a) V2 未 committed（"not committed"），缺乏不可篡改的时间证据；(b) 从 "raw p-values" 到 "BH-FDR corrected" 的转变本身就是一个 researcher degree of freedom。这不构成数据伪造，但确实削弱了 predict-then-verify 的 pre-registration 价值。 R2-Q6: T≤10 极短序列是否根本无法可靠因果推断？ [AGREE]  与我的 W3 一致。T=10 下 PermG power≈37%（Appendix N），这意味着可靠的因果推断（在传统 power≥80% 标准下）需要 T≥20 甚至更长。论文在 Limitations (p.8) 承认 "T≤25 observations, statistical power remains limited"，但这一承认被淹没在其他限制中。应更突出地讨论 minimum viable T 的问题——Appendix N 的 Figure 3 提供了 power curve，但未给出明确的 T_ min 推荐。 总体判断 R2 的审稿与我的 R1 高度互补： -  共识区域 : (1) FPR/power 的统计不足（R1-W1/W3 ↔ R2 未直接提出但与 Q6 相关）；(2) 跨架构泛化性不足（R1-W5 ↔ R2-W3）；(3) Proposition 3 的实证基础薄弱（R1-W4 ↔ R2-W1）；(4) Discussion 过短（R2-W4）。 -  R2 独到的新视角 : (a) Framing 问题（W2, "landscape" 承诺过高）是重要的 presentation-level 批评；(b) Schaeffer et al. 的 collapse 定义对应（W6）是被忽视的 conceptual gap；(c) V1/V2 的 post-hoc adjustment 质疑（Q5）是严肃的方法论完整性问题。 -  我比 R2 更 critical 的地方 : fp32/bf16 翻转（R1-W2）、mechanical coupling（R1-W6）、intervention 实验的多重局限（R1-W7）——这些 R2 未提及但我认为同等或更重要。 维持我的评分 : Overall 3.0 (Findings)，与 R2 一致。R2 的额外论点（特别是 W1 curve-fitting circularity 和 W2 framing mismatch）进一步 consolidate 了这一判断。

524	However, method-level heterogeneity emerges: Toda--Yamamoto exhibits a non-monotonic pattern at $T{=}15$, inverting the PermG ordering in the mid-$\alpha$ range; gradual low-$\alpha$ dynamics preserve VAR lag structure, while rapid entropy saturation disrupts lag dependence at intermediate $\alpha$, with recovery at $\alpha{=}0.75$ where extreme collapse dynamics (PPL drift ${+}390\%$) generate sufficient temporal variation to support VAR detection.
525	Onset-zone attenuation is $\alpha$-invariant at 1.4B: both $\alpha{=}0.45$ and $0.50$ yield 3/6 at $T{=}15$.

527	Cross-method consensus ($K{\geq}3$) exhibits seed-dependent variability at onset ($\alpha{\approx}0.50$), consistent with the noisy transition expected at phase boundaries, while remaining robust above onset ($K{\geq}3$ ${\geq}5/6$ at $\alpha{=}0.75$).
528	On a unified 6-pair basis (MAUVE excluded due to systematic floor at ${\sim}0.033$; Table~\ref{tab:14b_phase}), third-seed replication (s44) at $T{=}10$ confirms ceiling detection above onset (6/6 at $\alpha{\geq}0.50$) with 0/6 at $\alpha{=}0.45$, validating the blind zone.
529	Cross-$T$ improvement holds at 3/4 $\alpha$ values ($\alpha{=}0.45$: $0/6{\to}5/6$; $\alpha{=}0.60$: $6/6{\to}6/6$; $\alpha{=}0.75$: $6/6{\to}6/6$), validating the predicted $\alpha_c(T)$ decrease; at onset ($\alpha{=}0.50$), PermG shows a marginal decrease ($6/6{\to}3/6$), consistent with phase-boundary variability.

However, method-level heterogeneity emerges: Toda--Yamamoto exhibits a non-monotonic pattern at $T{=}15$, inverting the PermG ordering in the mid-$\alpha$ range; gradual low-$\alpha$ dynamics preserve VAR lag structure, while rapid entropy saturation disrupts lag dependence at intermediate $\alpha$, with recovery at $\alpha{=}0.75$ where extreme collapse dynamics (PPL drift ${+}390\%$) generate sufficient temporal variation to support VAR detection.
Onset-zone attenuation is $\alpha$-invariant at 1.4B: both $\alpha{=}0.45$ and $0.50$ yield 3/6 at $T{=}15$.
At 1.4B with $T{=}10$ (11 data points), non-PermG methods (threshold onset, naive cross-correlation, Toda--Yamamoto) have insufficient power due to short sequence length, reducing $K{\geq}3$ consensus to an effective single-method test; at $T{=}15$ (16 data points), detection recovers (6/6 at $\alpha{=}0.60$, lead time ${=}$ 10 generations) and $K{\geq}3$ recovers its multi-method character, with all four $\alpha$ conditions achieving $K{\geq}3{\geq}2/6$.
Cross-method consensus ($K{\geq}3$) exhibits seed-dependent variability at onset ($\alpha{\approx}0.50$), consistent with the noisy transition expected at phase boundaries, while remaining robust above onset ($K{\geq}3$ ${\geq}5/6$ at $\alpha{=}0.75$).
On a unified 6-pair basis (MAUVE excluded due to systematic floor at ${\sim}0.033$; Table~\ref{tab:14b_phase}), third-seed replication (s44) at $T{=}10$ confirms ceiling detection above onset (6/6 at $\alpha{\geq}0.50$) with 0/6 at $\alpha{=}0.45$, validating the blind zone.
Cross-$T$ improvement holds at 3/4 $\alpha$ values ($\alpha{=}0.45$: $0/6{\to}5/6$; $\alpha{=}0.60$: $6/6{\to}6/6$; $\alpha{=}0.75$: $6/6{\to}6/6$), validating the predicted $\alpha_c(T)$ decrease; at onset ($\alpha{=}0.50$), PermG shows a marginal decrease ($6/6{\to}3/6$), consistent with phase-boundary variability.

At 1.4B with $T{=}10$ (11 data points), non-PermG methods (threshold onset, naive cross-correlation, Toda--Yamamoto) have insufficient power due to short sequence length, reducing $K{\geq}3$ consensus to an effective single-method test; at $T{=}15$ (16 data points), detection recovers (6/6 at $\alpha{=}0.60$, lead time ${=}$ 10 generations) and $K{\geq}3$ recovers its multi-method character, with 3/4 $\alpha$ conditions achieving $K{\geq}3{\geq}2/6$ (onset $\alpha{=}0.50$ seed-dependent: s42 1/6, s43 3/6).
Cross-method consensus ($K{\geq}3$) exhibits seed-dependent variability at onset ($\alpha{\approx}0.50$), consistent with the noisy transition expected at phase boundaries, while remaining robust above onset ($K{\geq}3$ ${\geq}5/6$ at $\alpha{=}0.75$).
